def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, hms = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + hms
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    return {'stored': [dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second + (dt.day - 1) * 86400], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    seconds = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1, sp2, day_width = layout
    day = str((seconds // 86400) + 1).zfill(day_width)
    seconds %= 86400
    hour = seconds // 3600
    seconds %= 3600
    minute = seconds // 60
    second = seconds % 60
    hms = f'{hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02}'
    month = 'Jan'  # This example assumes 'Jan'; replace with actual month logic if needed.
    return month + (' ' * sp1) + day + (' ' * sp2) + hms
